aggregate.note: descriptive only: not a development score, not a gate, and the clear count is not a pass rate

verdict.what_this_is: descriptive four-arm development run: seed0 B0/B1/B2/B3 checkpoints, identical dev seeds and S1N ruler

limits: This is a descriptive dev ruler, not a development score and not a gate: a handful of dev episodes is only a SMOKE, and even 20 episodes per arm has no pre-registered decision rule, no interval-based arm comparison and no pass/fail verdict.
The checkpoint is a WP04.2 behaviour-cloning baseline (chosen one-hot CE on D410-S1, last epoch only), not an RL-trained policy and not the final student.

No G410-2 conclusion: the confirm split 60000-60199 is never read, there is no G410-2 protocol, no four-arm gate matrix and no pass rate. Frames, deaths, stop_reason, clear count and the action distribution are descriptive only.
The Wilson intervals are descriptive, computed over the scheduled episodes (a failed episode counts as a non-clear); they are not a confidence interval for any pre-registered pass rate.

B1/B3 carry a bomb head but this ruler has no bomb channel: the head is read and recorded, never actuated, so all four arms play the same move-only rule. On D410-S1 the bomb label is 0 on every row, so the auxiliary term has no positive class to learn.
The confirm split is refused by check_seed_policy and the D410-S1 corpus seeds 1-20 are refused too, so a checkpoint can never be scored on a seed it saw.
The policy sees only pixels + its own action history; the engine STATE reply is a referee for death/stage/score, never an input.
Only one checkpoint per arm (BC training seed0) and only the last epoch were evaluated; there is no training-seed variance and no epoch selection.

The four arms differ in capacity and recipe as well as in the auxiliary term: B1-B0 and B3-B2 isolate the (constant-0) bomb aux inside one model space, B0-vs-B2 confounds model space with the spatial recipe.
not_claimed: not evidence that the WP04.2 BC matrix works in closed loop
not evidence that the bomb auxiliary head helps (its label is constant 0)
